incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: private-controlplane(acme-corp) - control-plane-heartbeat-failed fired for 3 separate agents in us-west-2. Escalation policy: infra-oncall. page at 1959998888

pagerduty: Incident 8964123 created and assigned to alice-sre. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENT-8964123

alice-sre: ack'ing — looking now. seeing repeated 503s from the control plane health endpoint. customer-reported no new deploys.

bob-oncall: joining. any evidence of network blackholes or route flaps? I see BGP noise earlier but not same AS.

alice-sre: curl from our mgmt plane to private control plane endpoint times out intermittently. logs show: `health_check: last_success=2024-11-02T02:31:10Z, failures=5, error=connection reset`

frank-infra: I can run traceroute to the customer's VPC control-plane ELB. running: `mtr -r -c 20 vip-acme-ctrl.us-west-2.redwood.internal`

carla-se: CC'ing acme SE (on slack/email) — customer says they can't reach the agent dashboard and some inference jobs are stuck in PENDING. reported ~10% of their requests failing.

alice-sre: quick mitigation plan: 1) confirm it's not a control-plane overload (cpu/mem) 2) check agent heartbeats 3) attempt a controlled restart of control-plane pods behind the ELB if needed 4) coordinate with customer to check VPC NACLs and SG.

grace-oncall: taking network checks. I see increased SYN retries between our nat-gw and customer subnet 10.44.21.0/24 starting 1959998800. Could be a transient route change at the customer edge.

bob-oncall: can we add a temporary route via spare transit gateway to restore connectivity? that's risky but might buy time.

alice-sre: before broad routing change, let's confirm with customer. carla, can you ping SE to ask if they changed any firewall rules or gateways?

carla-se: pinged acme network lead (tim). Tim says they rolled a firmware update on their edge firewall around 02:28 UTC and reverted it at 02:38 UTC. They think it might have dropped some established connections but claims it's reverted.

frank-infra: checking our ELB logs. seeing repeated TLS handshake failures to three agent IPs: 10.44.21.15, 10.44.21.23, 10.44.21.42. LB returned 502 for those backend targets.

alice-sre: OK looks like customer-side edge caused transient connection resets. mitigation: 1) drain and restart the affected agent instances so they re-establish fresh TLS sessions; 2) enable short-term 5s keepalive on the control plane -> agent connections to reduce TTL-broken sessions; 3) open a support ticket with acme to do a deeper network review.

bob-oncall: i'll prep the restart cmds, keeping canary first. Command: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/acme-agent --namespace=acme-prod --selector=instance in (10-44-21-15,10-44-21-23)``` canary for 2 mins then full.

alice-sre: executing canary restart now. monitoring.

incident-bot: deploy bot: rollout restart triggered for deploy/acme-agent (canary). Job id: job-654321.

alice-sre: canary looks good — heartbeats restored for 10.44.21.15 after 45s. CPU and mem normal. Moving to full restart.

carla-se: acme confirms they see reduced failures at their side (their logs show agent reconnects). they will run deeper packet captures and share after-hours if needed.

frank-infra: enabling temporary 5s keepalive on control-plane LB backend config. patch applied.

grace-oncall: routing stable now, no more SYN retries. monitoring for 10 more minutes before declaring recovery.

alice-sre: marking service impact as partial: ~10% of requests affected for ~12 minutes. mitigation applied (agent restarts + keepalive + customer revert).

dave-cs: looped in account team and notified customer success — sent status update to customer at 03:10 UTC.

bob-oncall: handing off to grace for next shift window. grace — you're on followup and postmortem. i've added tasks to incident board. :white_check_mark:

grace-oncall: got it. i'll own the postmortem. initial RCA: customer firewall firmware caused established TLS sessions to drop, our agents didn't re-establish fast enough due to default keepalive. Action items: 1) default keepalive down to 5s for private control-plane connections (config PR) 2) add agent-side faster reconnection jitter for private deployments (agent issue) 3) run runbook reminder to contact customer before rolling infra changes (seems acme didn't notify infra) 4) add alert to detect >3 agents in a customer VPC failing health in 5m window.

alice-sre: creating postmortem doc and linking to incident: https://redwood-internal/docs/incidents/INC-8964123-postmortem

incident-bot: Incident 8964123 status -> RESOLVED at 1959999420 by alice-sre. Summary: transient customer edge firewall update caused TLS session drops; we restarted affected agents and adjusted keepalive; customer impact ~10% requests for 12 minutes.

carla-se: customer thank-you note: "Thanks for fast response. We'll coordinate change windows going forward." :thumbsup:

grace-oncall: followups assigned to frank-infra and alice-sre. closing thread but keeping watch for 24h.
